prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1272; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Nothing independent confirms the accident: no witnesses, no photos and no other report.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: On the afternoon of the reported collision, officers responded to an intersection in Katy, Texas, where a side impact between two vehicles had occurred. Driver 1 was operating the vehicle that struck the passenger side of Driver 2's car as it entered the crossing. Driver 1 provided an insurance card listing Driver 1 as the named insured on the policy. Driver 1 told officers of a headache and confusion following the impact and reported a concussion. Passenger was seated in the front right position of Driver 2's vehicle and was present at the scene, and both the responding officers and the on-scene witnesses confirmed that Passenger was inside the vehicle at the time of the collision. Damage to both vehicles is consistent with the direction and force of the described impact. Driver 2 reported no prior damage to the vehicle, and none was observed. No independent witnesses came forward, no photographs were submitted, and no other report of the incident was located at the time of this writing. Officers will forward the file for supplemental review.
